I am **LUO Qun (罗群)**. My work connects Earth system science with artificial intelligence, with a particular interest in physically interpretable prediction.

My background is in groundwater science and water engineering. I have worked on river water quality, precipitation nowcasting, human influences on runoff, and seasonal ocean forecasting. Across these topics, I am interested in how models can make useful predictions while helping us understand the processes behind them.

## Education

### The Hong Kong Polytechnic University · from September 2026

**Full-time PhD programme, Department of Computing**\
Joint supervision with EIT Institute for Advanced Study.\
Supervisors: **Prof. Jiannong Cao** (PolyU) and **Dr. Yuntian Chen** (EIT).

### Beijing Normal University · September 2022 – June 2025

**Master's degree in Water Engineering**, College of Water Sciences.\
Supervisor: **Prof. Dingzhi Peng**.

### China University of Geosciences (Beijing) · September 2018 – June 2022

**Bachelor of Engineering in Groundwater Science and Engineering**.

## Research experience

### Southern University of Science and Technology

**Research Assistant**, Earth System & Global Change Lab; joined July 2025.\
Supervisor: **Dr. Zhenzhong Zeng**.

Research on deep learning for seasonal sea surface temperature forecasting and the drivers and prediction of algal blooms.

## Research interests

- Physically interpretable AI for Earth system processes
- Seasonal sea surface temperature forecasting
- Precipitation nowcasting and satellite precipitation
- Water quality prediction and hydrological modelling
- Human activity, climate variability, and runoff change

## 中文简介

我是罗群，研究兴趣是地球系统科学与人工智能，尤其关注预测方法的物理可解释性。本科就读于中国地质大学（北京）地下水科学与工程专业，硕士就读于北京师范大学水科学研究院水利工程专业。2025 年 7 月加入南方科技大学地球系统与全球变化相关研究团队任科研助理，研究海表温度季节预测等问题。博士项目为香港理工大学计算学系与 EIT 联合培养项目，起始时间为 2026 年 9 月。
